name: Sprewell Bluff Park, River Ridge Campground
evidence: satellite (leaf-off, 700 m + 270 m frames) at 32.87125,-84.47353: RV clearings on the ridge road ~180 m from the Flint River through continuous forest; DEM 257 m at camp vs ~173 m near the river. No open sightline; Firefly's 'views' is marketing. Not waterfront, no view earned.

name: Bear Branch RV Park
evidence: satellite z19 at 32.5477,-82.1281 (leaf-off, checked by a second read): 3-5 RVs along the south shore of a cove of George L. Smith millpond, ~10-15 m from water, partly shaded. Lakefront not earned: no open apron, no operator site, and nightly booking of that row unconfirmed (478-494-0094), so down to lakeview.

name: George T. Bagby State Park
evidence: newer satellite z19 (construction stage) at 31.6587,-85.0611: pin was the day-use beach, new loops 825 m south. West-loop outer pads ~25 m from Lake Walter F. George across open ground, a track and sparse fringe; north-loop pads are behind a ~20 m tree band. RA 'no waterfront' icons (20 of first 25 rows, cottages included) decide nothing. Recheck on finished imagery.

name: River Campground & Lodge
evidence: operator per-site map (garivercampground.com/map): RV sites 6b, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12 in a row on the Tallulah's north bank; satellite z19 at 34.7770,-83.3985 shows a white RV ~10-15 m from the water west of Joy Bridge, shore row in partial canopy. River ~20-25 m wide there, so creekside. #10's river view is obstructed per operator. Prior look was south of the river.

name: A Big Wheel RV Park
evidence: operator park map (abigwheelrvpark.com/park-map.html): nightly 'Pond Site' P01-P05 ($50, electric or water+electric) between road and pond, ~5-15 m from the bank; map scale checks against satellite z19 at 30.8368,-81.5642 (road ~25 m from pond, open grass with scattered oaks). Pond ~0.3 ha. Full-hookup rows are ~45 m+ off and do not count; pads not visible in imagery.

name: Blythe Island Regional Park
evidence: kept per --AWH firsthand ('some sites may have a water view, not confirmed'); satellite z18 at 31.1563,-81.5427 canopy-blind, pale shore strip on Lake Cindee's south bank, sites not legible. County prices sites 1-13 as Lakeview at $45; ask logged.

name: Florence Marina State Park
evidence: GA DNR park map (FlorenceMarina_TrailMap.pdf): sites 1-43 in loops east of the park road, with clubhouse, mini-golf and picnic area between them and the reservoir. Satellite at 32.0955,-85.0460: nearest loop ~170 m from Lake Walter F. George behind a field and treeline. Prior evidence was from another spot (32.0858,-85.0432).

name: Doll Mountain Campground
evidence: rec.gov tags RV site 12 Lakefront (others tagged are tent-only, 15 ft), but satellite z19 at 34.6017,-84.6172 legibly contradicts: the peninsula loop's pads and site 12's coordinates sit ~50 m from shore through continuous forest; DEM ~345 m at the site vs ~330 m 170 m south. No apron or open sightline. Site 12 Driveway Length also conflicts (22 vs 50 ft).
